_note: Pipeline configuration read by operations/day_pipeline.py. No credential, no desktop path (D34). Host scripts run over SSM and must end with one line: PIPELINE_RECEIPT {json} carrying the gate fields in day_pipeline.GATES. Everything per-run reaches a host script as a prepended PowerShell assignment: $Day always, plus host_variables. The Windows host uses .ps1 today; the Linux host image (spec prerequisite 5) swaps these for .sh with no other change.
_ingest_on: runner = the gold-standard journal stack as the workflow's own job (4-vCPU runner, parent + 3 workers, recorded with --record); host = the same stack over SSM on the declared instance (parent + every other CPU), for the 32/48-CPU host once Greg names it and its OS
_host_scripts: ingest is null on purpose (Greg, 2026-09-17): ingestion stays the journal-stack job already on git, recorded with --record ingest. There is no second ingestion path to build or pay for. ingest_on: host would now be refused by name rather than run a script that does not exist.
_host_variables: Filled when Greg authors the fresh run configuration; the scripts refuse any value still reading HOST_*. ToolsRoot is the lawful checkout at the reviewed BOSS commit (the retained scripts used C:\tools\Markets), Python the host interpreter, RunRoot the parent holding <RunRoot>\<Day>\actual-host-configuration.json and that day's run directory.
